title: Standard Markus front end in core (StandardMarkusProjector)
description: One standard front end for Markus static sites, configured by projection.json: URL policy, environment guard, head builder, sitemap/robots/404, RSS+Atom, listings and tags, accessible components, named hooks, pattern redirects compiled into the edge function. Opt-in by a top-level site object.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Distinctive Mark is live on the standard Markus front end with Papyrus 5.4.0 (Distinctive-web a6b0c4e + a3da54d, Amplify job 16 SUCCEED; job 15 on 5.3.0 failed on the monitoring-view bundling regression fixed in 5.4.0). Live checks 2026-10-21: all 7 pre-migration sitemap URLs, /feed.xml and the 404 return the same statuses; the sitemap lists the same 7 URLs; /atom.xml and /feed.xml are well-formed (0 entries: nothing published yet); /llms.txt and .md twins (/index.md, /rulings/index.md, /guides/index.md, text/markdown) present; pages carry the skip link, main#main, Atom link and Twitter cards. lastmod and llms-full.txt appear once items are published (verified in a local build with launch content). 33 site tests pass.
